title: Kitty Recovery: Builder control plane V3
description: Retry the current Builder control-plane sequence after V2 proved the runtime fix and then correctly hit a scope fence because gateway/_work_projection_item.py was omitted from the packet. V2 partial work is preserved separately; V3 adds only that required projection file to allowed_paths.

packets.title: Packet self-review, freshness, and cost preflight
packets.objective: Make the next current Builder packet reviewable before execution and show its projected route/cost. Reuse existing manifest validation, initiative status, doctor/preflight, durable packet metadata, and compute governor. Detect stale/invalid work without creating an attempt or changing task/run state, and show the pre-run decision in Work with plain-language refusal when execution is unsafe.
acceptance_criteria: A current packet can be revalidated before launch without creating an attempt or changing task/run state.
Missing or stale packet inputs produce a durable/plain-language blocked or refusal reason rather than silently launching.
The next runnable packet exposes its projected route and estimated CAD cost before launch; free work is clearly estimated at CAD 0.
Paid estimates are checked against remaining weekly budget and all cost figures remain labelled as local estimates, not provider invoices.
Work exposes the preflight result/action in place while existing post-implementation independent reviewer separation remains unchanged.
No duplicate reviewer state machine, price registry, ledger, or budget store is introduced.
Focused Builder, compute-governor, supervisor, Work tests, and TypeScript pass.
validation_commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_builder_commands.py tests/test_builder_routes.py tests/test_builder_initiative.py tests/test_builder_status.py tests/test_compute_governor.py tests/test_builder_supervisor.py tests/test_builder_supervisor_api.py tests/test_work_projection.py
cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/WorkViewActions.test.tsx tests/WorkViewProjection.test.tsx --reporter=dot

packets.title: Ask Builder from the Work cockpit
packets.objective: Add a compact Builder conversation/control entry point to Work so Jacob can describe a bounded task, inspect the prepared proposal, explicitly send it, and then see status/recovery inline. Reuse the existing Builder conversation propose/approve/resume endpoints and BuilderProposalCard flow; do not create another queue, chat backend, or mission store.
acceptance_criteria: Work provides an obvious in-place way to ask Builder for bounded work rather than only navigating elsewhere.
The flow reuses existing conversation propose/approve/resume APIs and produces the same durable initiative/packet records as chat.
Proposal details are reviewable before explicit send; durable IDs and raw server details stay hidden from normal UI.
Queued, running, blocked, exhausted, paused, review, cancelled, and completed recovery remain actionable or explicitly explained inline.
Desktop and iPhone-class layouts remain usable with no horizontal overflow; focused UI tests and TypeScript pass.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/BuilderProposalCard.test.tsx tests/WorkViewActions.test.tsx tests/WorkViewProjection.test.tsx --reporter=dot

packets.title: Truthful unattended supervisor status
packets.objective: Make Builder autonomy observable and trustworthy. Verify the supported macOS scheduled-supervisor path, persist or derive enough scheduler/tick evidence to report whether unattended execution is installed/healthy, and ensure scheduled runs use the exact same free-first dispatch gates, retry limits, preflight, reviewer separation, and approval boundaries as manual Start Builder.
acceptance_criteria: Work truthfully reports whether scheduled Builder execution is installed/healthy; it never fabricates last-tick or next-run data.
The scheduled path and manual Start Builder path share the same dispatchability and safety gates.
With a current free packet available, the supported scheduler can advance it without a UI click; when no current packet exists it starts nothing.
Autonomous execution remains free-first and cannot push, open a PR, merge, provision paid infrastructure, or alter credentials without explicit approval.
Focused supervisor/route/UI tests pass, launchd configuration is validated, and TypeScript remains clean.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/WorkViewActions.test.tsx --reporter=dot
